summary: Window sessions are 33,596 (Direct 51.1%, Organic Search 33.2%) and Constant Contact is connected, but UTM leakage still hides email's real impact. The Oct 21 Alumni Day Of send was the standout (+90.0% lift) while the Oct 25 and Oct 27 sends lifted negatively.
working: Alumni eNews 'Day Of: October 2026' (Oct 21) lifted daily sessions +90.0% with 39 Email-attributed sessions in 3 days and a 1.66% click rate, the best recent send.
Constant Contact opens beat the 25-35% benchmark: 49.15% average across 100 campaigns (330,682 total sends); Alumni sends run 44.9-48.6% opens and Staff-Client Oct 25 hit 40.11%.
Day-of and reminder style sends keep winning: Alumni Reminder August 2026 lifted +686.0%, and the Oct 21 Day Of send +90.0%, versus -20.3% for the Oct 11 main Alumni send.
Email channel grew from 186 to 192 sessions since the Oct 26 run, and total window sessions rose 33,573 to 33,596. Organic Search is steady at 11,149 sessions (33.2%).
Best 2026 click rates came from Alumni eNews Jan 2025 content (4.31%) and Staff-Client February 2026 (3.85%, +45.9% lift), showing educational and event content can earn clicks.
not_working: UTM leakage persists: in 2026, 45 sends show only 200 Email sessions in 3-day windows against 2,420 Direct sessions. Oct 16 Alumni Reminder shows 0 Email vs 37 Direct and Oct 11 Alumni shows 0 vs 48, so GA4 credits Email as Direct (Direct is 51.1% of sessions).
Oct 27 Referring Partners eNews underperformed: 24.46% open (below the 25-35% benchmark), 1.54% click, only 2 Email vs 14 Direct sessions, and -59.4% lift on a 973-person list.
Oct 25 Staff-Client eNews (4,490 sends) had a 0.65% click rate, 1.61% click-to-open and -35.4% lift; the arm B 3:30 PM test was nearly identical (0.56% click), so send time made no difference.
Average click rate is only 1.67% across 100 campaigns despite 49.15% opens, so subject lines work but in-email calls to action do not drive clicks.
Organic Social is weak at 5.1% of sessions (1,713) and flat vs last run (1,714); GSC shows only 9 clicks on 2,177 impressions at average position 15.5, meaning page-two rankings are not converting.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<send-name> to every newsletter link in Constant Contact; this is the single fix that will reveal email's true impact (200 vs 2,420 Direct sessions today).

Prioritize Alumni-style Day Of and Reminder sends (+90.0% and +686.0% lifts); consider adding a reminder or day-of send for the Staff-Client and Referring Partners lists, which currently get one send and negative lift.

Rework CTAs on Staff-Client and Referring Partners emails: one clear button above the fold, since click-to-open is 1.61% and 6.3% on these sends; skip further send-time tests as arm A and arm B matched.
Repromote the content themes behind the highest clicks (Feb 2026 Staff-Client at 3.85%, Jan 2025 Alumni at 4.31%) in the November edition and in social posts.

SEO: target the 40 GSC discovery candidates and pages ranking positions 8-20 (avg position 15.5, 9 clicks on 2,177 impressions) with title and meta refreshes and internal links to lift page-two queries.
